privileged_info_for_vlm: The BraTS 2021 dataset for case 00000 contains 4 sequences: T1, T1ce (contrast-enhanced), T2, and FLAIR. Each volume has dimensions 240x240x155. In a correct comparison, T2 and FLAIR will show bright fluid/edema, while T1ce will show bright enhancement around the tumor core compared to the standard T1.
